data.name: Makhtooma
data.gender_notes: Makhtooma is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'kh-t-m', meaning 'sealed' or 'completed'. In Islamic tradition, this name symbolizes a woman who is well-versed in knowledge and wisdom, with a strong commitment to sharing her insights with others. The name Makhtooma carries the meaning “Wise Scholar” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Makhtooma usually hope their child will grow to embody wise scholar and live with faith, good character and purpose.
